queue.title: Inside Harbinger's $300 Million EV Deal
queue.resumo: Harbinger Motors just landed a huge deal: 2,000 all‑electric trucks headed to FedEx in a contract worth over $300 million. Harbinger Motors CEO John Harris joins Bloomberg Open Interest to tell us how the EV maker plans to scale up, what soaring fuel prices mean for big fleets, and why demand is surging even without new green regulations. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: ECB Wary of Stepping Into French Bond Turmoil
queue.resumo: A sudden selloff of French bonds has stirred memories of the sovereign debt crisis that cascaded across Europe between 2009 and 2015. Attention is now turning to how the European Central Bank might respond. Virginie Maisonneuve, founder at Maisonneuve Global Advisors, discusses the global economic outlook and why the ECB is wary of the current French bond turmoil. (Source: Bloomberg)

queue.title: Stocks Fall as Oil Rally Spurs Treasury Volatility

(Source: Bloomberg)
